title: Magenta case: Mussolini's RS33 investigation group

tellings.quote:
And the magenta case is so interesting
because Mussolini thought it was a a
Nazi advanced craft or a British or
American advanced craft when he had his
own special investigation group, the
RS33, who was like really keen on the
fact this wasn't human technology and
then likely worked with the Nazis.

plain: In 1933, near Magenta in Italy, a craft is said to have crashed, and the Italian dictator Benito Mussolini first thought it was an advanced Nazi, British or American aircraft, while his own secret investigation team, called RS33, became convinced it was not human technology and likely worked with the Nazis on it. The online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells it without naming a source, mentioning David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who spoke about crash recoveries before Congress, and it matters because it would put the first recovery of such a craft years before the war.
